ideas.question: How has the proportion of SUID cases with hospital overnight stays changed over different time periods?
ideas.why_open: The incidence and factors contributing to sudden unexpected infant death have been extensively studied, but the role of hospital stays in SUID cases has not been thoroughly explored. Understanding trends over time could provide insights into preventive measures and healthcare practices.
ideas.data: For ncfrp_v51, use D82: Hospital Overnight Stay to identify whether the infant was returned to hospital overnight after delivery. For prams_p8_arf and prams_p7_arf, aggregate demographic information from D291 (Demographic Information) and hospital stay length from D279 (Hospital Stay Length). Analyze trends in proportions over time periods.

For prams_p8_arf and prams_p7_arf, aggregate demographic information from D291 (Demographic Information) and sleep arrangements from D281 (Sleeping Arrangements). Analyze trends in proportions over time periods.
